publicKeyEncoding: RFC 8410 SPKI DER, canonical strict unpadded base64url, re-export exact equality, asymmetricKeyType ed25519
signatureEncoding: 64 raw bytes, canonical strict unpadded base64url
bootId: CSPRNG 32 bytes per admission process instance
origin: Explicit HUMAN_CLIENT_HOST_ORIGIN; no Host/forwarded/Origin/payload authority derivation
omissions: sessionId does not exist at enrollment. enrollmentId not needed once session fixes approved key. nonceId doubles as challenge identity. Signature excluded from body digest to avoid circular signing. No root credentials in transcripts.
client: Sign exact decoded Host signingInput after validating fixed V1 purpose/envelope; do not reconstruct canonical JSON
verification: Exact stored bytes/key, synchronous Node verification, final current enrollment/admission/nonce/deadline check before consumption; issued receipt has no client-lifecycle dependency
testVector: ED25519_CROSS_RUNTIME_TEST_VECTORS.json; published RFC 8032 TEST 1 key; no production private key
crossRuntime: Node production crypto and independent Rust ed25519-dalek =2.2.0: 8 signature cases (4 valid/4 modified invalid) + 14 weak-key rejection cases; shared vector identities are not distinct threat scenarios.
pointEncodingValidation: Canonical compressed coordinate plus standard small-order encoding rejection on public key and signature R. Byte comparisons only; signing/verification remain Node crypto Ed25519. See libsodium 1.0.18 ge25519_has_small_order constants.
identity: Durable Ed25519 public-key enrollment; key persistence belongs to C2, not this Host gate
additionalSessionVector: ED25519_A1_SESSION_VECTORS.json preserves all original 22 checks and adds session-authenticate; independent Rust verifier now confirms 23 checks

A2AlgorithmAgility.Ed25519: Existing implementations, weak-point defenses, transcript and vectors unchanged

P256.SPKI: exact id-ecPublicKey + prime256v1 named curve DER; uncompressed SEC1 point; canonical re-export equality
P256.digest: D=SHA256(exact existing signingInput bytes); Node sha256 verify on M, Rust prehash verify on D
P256.DER: not Host wire; test-only provider conversion fixture
